{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "nonpolar_surface_lipophilicity_core",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_rich_partitioning",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_high"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "Halogens add hydrophobic surface and polarizability, a classic driver of higher octanol-water partitioning."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_pi_surface",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Extended aromatic pi systems present nonpolar surface that partitions favorably into octanol."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "High heteroatom density raises hydrogen bonding and desolvation cost, suppressing measured logD."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "ring_rich_scaffold",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Ring role carried the strongest source transfer weight (0.758); fused rings add rigid hydrophobic surface."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 0.8,
      "prior_scale": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.16,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.62,
      "hypothesis": "Merges the two development families: hydrophobic surface from halogen and aromatic content plus the high-transfer ring role, penalized by heteroatom density. Fails if halogen_high (98 candidates) is too sparse to inform the surrogate."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "polarity_dominant_counter_hypothesis",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "low_heteroatom_nonpolar",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_low"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis: polarity, not bulk size, sets lipophilicity; few heteroatoms means weak hydration."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "length_relation_downweighted",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": 0.15,
          "rationale": "Length transfer is low confidence (0.224, prior weight 0.040), so its reversed sign is kept but heavily downweighted."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "flexible_branch_penalty",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_high"},
          "weight": -0.3,
          "rationale": "Rotatable-bond role transferred at 0.758; flexible polar branches add hydration without nonpolar surface."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_halogen_synergy",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_mid"},
          "weight": 0.2,
          "rationale": "Moderate aromaticity covers a large pool (1619) with meaningful nonpolar surface but less polar substitution."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.2,
      "prior_scale": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.48,
      "hypothesis": "Reverses emphasis: polarity and flexibility dominate while the uncertain size relation is nearly zeroed. Fails if bulk molecular size, not polarity, actually orders lipophilicity in this pool.",
      "revision_note": "counter-hypothesis"
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "nonpolar_surface_lipophilicity_core",
  "lesson": "Across two generations of eight development seeds the two families converged (89.04/88.93 vs 85.73/89.26 mean AUC), so the earlier apparent advantage of hydrophobic-surface rules was not stable; seed-level noise exceeds the between-skill gap, and the shared ring/heteroatom terms are the most defensible components.",
  "revision_summary": "Because the two prior families performed indistinguishably in generation 1, I merged their overlapping mechanistic rules (halogen, aromatic, heteroatom penalty, high-transfer ring role) into one deployed skill and dropped the low-transfer extreme-length rule. The second skill is an explicit counter-hypothesis that nearly zeroes the uncertain length relation and instead emphasizes polarity and flexibility, with higher ridge and lower semantic mass to reduce variance. Deployment is frozen before held-out evaluation; no target outcomes were observed."
}

rules.rationale: Halogens add hydrophobic surface and polarizability, a classic driver of higher octanol-water partitioning.
Extended aromatic pi systems present nonpolar surface that partitions favorably into octanol.
High heteroatom density raises hydrogen bonding and desolvation cost, suppressing measured logD.
Ring role carried the strongest source transfer weight (0.758); fused rings add rigid hydrophobic surface.

skills.hypothesis: Merges the two development families: hydrophobic surface from halogen and aromatic content plus the high-transfer ring role, penalized by heteroatom density. Fails if halogen_high (98 candidates) is too sparse to inform the surrogate.

Rotatable-bond role transferred at 0.758; flexible polar branches add hydration without nonpolar surface.

normalized.lesson: Across two generations of eight development seeds the two families converged (89.04/88.93 vs 85.73/89.26 mean AUC), so the earlier apparent advantage of hydrophobic-surface rules was not stable; seed-level noise exceeds the between-skill gap, and the shared ring/heteroatom terms are the most defensible components.
normalized.revision_summary: Because the two prior families performed indistinguishably in generation 1, I merged their overlapping mechanistic rules (halogen, aromatic, heteroatom penalty, high-transfer ring role) into one deployed skill and dropped the low-transfer extreme-length rule. The second skill is an explicit counter-hypothesis that nearly zeroes the uncertain length relation and instead emphasizes polarity and flexibility, with higher ridge and lower semantic mass to reduce variance. Deployment is frozen before held-out evaluation; no target outcomes were observed.
